remarks: Imagine waking up to the gentle coastal breeze in this beautifully proportioned 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium for sale in Long Beach, CA. Your weekends begin with a short stroll down the street to grab a fresh pour-over coffee in the thriving Zaferia District, before heading out for a morning bike ride along the nearby beach paths or hitting the links at the Recreation Park golf course. Positioned perfectly on the second floor of the secure Views of the Pacific community, this 1,023-square-foot turnkey condo stands out as the largest available floor plan in the complex.
